eyebrow.zh: 完整召回内容送到本地仪表盘，MCP 返回精简回执，让人可以检查记忆而不把全文重复塞进模型上下文。
eyebrow.en: Send full recalls to a local dashboard and return compact MCP receipts, so people can review memories without repeating their full text in model context.

headline.zh: 在本地界面回看召回的记忆。

sub.zh: 完整召回内容送到本地仪表盘，MCP 返回精简回执，让人可以检查记忆而不把全文重复塞进模型上下文。
sub.en: Send full recalls to a local dashboard and return compact MCP receipts, so people can review memories without repeating their full text in model context.

caption.zh: 图示展示组件关系；实际输出见下方示例。
caption.en: An illustrative component scene; recorded output appears below.

body.en: Full text follows the local display route.

body.zh: 模型收到固定字段结构。
body.en: The model receives a fixed field structure.

body.zh: SQLite 和向量可由调用方控制。
body.en: Callers control SQLite and supplied vectors.

body.zh: 检查 Agent 记住了什么与让模型重新读取这些记忆，是两种不同操作。MemPeek 为前者提供本地回看路径：把命中的内容显示给人，模型拿到条数和地址等回执。模型若需要利用记忆全文，仍需由调用方另行提供。
body.en: Inspecting what an agent remembers and asking a model to reason over those memories are different operations. MemPeek provides a local readback route for inspection: people receive the matching content while the model gets counts and a location receipt. If the model needs the text for reasoning, the caller must provide it separately.

body.zh: 脚本向临时 SQLite 写入两条记忆，显式按 demo 会话召回一条，并通过进程内 SSEBus 收到全文。没有启动模型或浏览器仪表盘。token_saved 是启发式内容估算。
body.en: The script writes two memories to temporary SQLite, explicitly scopes recall to the demo session and delivers full text through an in-process SSEBus. It starts no model or browser dashboard. token_saved is a heuristic content estimate.

alt.en: The script writes two memories to temporary SQLite, explicitly scopes recall to the demo session and delivers full text through an in-process SSEBus. It starts no model or browser dashboard. token_saved is a heuristic content estimate.

body.zh: MemoryStore 将内容与向量写入 SQLite，按 cosine 相似度召回。MCP readback 将精简条目发布到 SSEBus，仪表盘经 HTTP/SSE 接收；回执只包含 found、displayed、token_saved、side_channel。默认向量来自哈希词袋，调用方也可提供向量。
body.en: MemoryStore persists text and vectors in SQLite and recalls by cosine similarity. MCP readback publishes lean entries through SSEBus to the HTTP/SSE dashboard. The receipt contains found, displayed, token_saved and side_channel. Default vectors are hashed bags of words; callers can supply their own.

The receipt contains found, displayed, token_saved and side_channel. Default vectors are hashed bags of words; callers can supply their own.

body.zh: 默认同一进程运行 MCP stdio 与仪表盘，也可单独启用一侧。session_id 用于查询过滤，in_context 是调用方标记，不是对 Agent 实际上下文的自动探测。
body.en: MCP stdio and the dashboard normally share one process; either can run alone. session_id filters queries and in_context is a caller-supplied label, not automatic inspection of the agent’s actual context.

body.zh: `--db=mempeek.db`、`--port=7331`、`--host=127.0.0.1`、`--session=default` 控制运行位置。`--http-only`/`--mcp-only` 选择传输；embedding 可提供给写入与查询。回执的 displayed 标志不是浏览器已阅读或成功渲染的确认。
body.en: `--db=mempeek.db`, `--port=7331`, `--host=127.0.0.1` and `--session=default` control runtime placement. `--http-only`/`--mcp-only` select transports. Embeddings can be supplied to writes and queries. The receipt’s displayed flag is not an acknowledgement that a browser rendered or a person read the content.

body.zh: model_receipt 不含全文，side_channel_content 包含匹配的记忆。
body.en: model_receipt omits full text while side_channel_content contains the matching memory.

body.zh: 需要 Node.js 22+。better-sqlite3 需要匹配本机 Node 的二进制；如果安装时没有可用预构建包，需要本机编译工具。
body.en: Requires Node.js 22+. better-sqlite3 needs a binary matching the local Node runtime; native build tools are required if no prebuilt binary is available.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/mempeek.git
cd mempeek
npm ci
npm run build

limitations.zh: 回执本身会占用 token；token_saved 未扣除回执，也不是实测账单或净节省。
limitations.en: Receipts themselves consume tokens; token_saved does not subtract receipt cost and is not measured billing or net savings.

limitations.zh: 默认哈希向量不是语义模型；未传 session_id 的召回可能遍历多个会话。
limitations.en: The default hashed vectorizer is not a semantic model; recall without session_id can span multiple sessions.
